source: 搜神记 第一卷 第二章 谪仙人 / 白衣女子初问笛声
title: 仙音初问，少年失神
purpose: 承接白衣女子月下现身，表现她垂箫询问、拓拔野竹笛坠地失神、白龙鹿同样怔住，以及拓拔野强作镇定赞其箫声如仙乐的第一轮对话段落。画面只做无声视觉，不生成口播或字幕。

continuity_from.source_grounding: E:\workspace\ComfyUIProjects\搜神记.txt gb18030 excerpt after 白衣女子淡然询问方才笛声。

image_reference_policy: Use one strong reference image per storyboard workflow. SH01 uses adult Yushiqie reference to stabilize the white-clothed woman. SH02 uses Tuobaye turnaround for face/costume/flute prop. SH03 uses previous SC07 reaction storyboard to preserve encounter layout. SH04 uses Tuobaye turnaround to keep the awkward self-conscious pose and Wufeng/bamboo flute props stable.
video_policy: Gemini experimental I2V should use only each generated and approved storyboard image as source of truth. No extra character or location references in video generation.

localization_policy.screen_text: Do not generate readable text, captions, subtitles, UI, signs, labels, plaques, speech bubbles, musical notes, or English words inside image/video.
localization_policy.dialogue_audio: Do not ask the video model to synthesize spoken dialogue, lip-sync, flute audio, heartbeat audio, or xiao audio. Chinese dialogue, narration, heartbeat, flute/xiao sound design, and subtitles should be added later in editing.
production_dialogue_lines: 方才的笛子，是公子吹奏的吗？
难怪……只有仙女才能吹出这等仙乐。
